purpose: Tracks promotion of verified academic plant signals into the canonical evidence matrix without changing public feeding verdicts.

not_promoted.reason: No matching canonical food row was verified in the current evidence matrix; do not invent a master identity solely to absorb a study signal.
Master row is Sedum sarmentosum; related-genus context remains explicitly non-exact.
Evidence is T. g. graeca and the master mallow identity is genus-level/identity-blocked; it remains related-species evidence only.

guardrails: Wild occurrence is not a captive diet percentage.
Genus-level observation is not species-level proof.
Related Testudo graeca populations are not relabeled as Ibera evidence.
Clinical association is not causality unless demonstrated.
Food composition does not set feeding safety, frequency, diet role, or evidence grade.
